gate_results.notes: Edit Mode run of NoSafeCircle.DoorPrototype.Tests.Editor.Rooms.RoomWallAccentIntegrationTests at the validated commit: total 5, passed 5, failed 0, Unity exit 0, Git tree equal to Post-run tree so the run mutated nothing. One case per room, confirmed present by classname in the results XML rather than inferred from the count. NOT PROVEN BY THIS GATE, and stated because the contract's wording invites the assumption: the fixture builds each room into a fresh in-memory scene and reads no committed scene, so it establishes the BUILDERS place accents and not that any committed scene contains them. That the five committed room scenes and the composed played scene do carry the accents was established separately by the re-bake at c27dc7e6 - WallAccents 0 to 1 in each room scene and 0 to 5 in DoorPrototype.unity, with CornerAccent exactly 4 per room - and is guarded going forward by FiveCommittedRoomScenes_EachCarryTheirWallAccents.

human_approval.notes: NSC-126 has one completion gate, VAL-001, and it is an automated Edit Mode gate; the contract names no human gate, so no human approval is claimed and none is implied.
